name: Stunned
description:
A {{sonne}} creature is out of the fight but still conscious. It is {{immobilise}}, it cannot act or take any {{reaction}}, and it speaks only with difficulty.

It fails every {{force}} and {{dexterite}} {{jet}}, and {{attaque|Attacks}} made against it gain 1 {{avantage}}.

The Skill that applies it says how long the state lasts.
